caption: P1 on S1 waits for P2 on S2, P2 waits for P3 on S3, and P3 waits for P1. Probes follow these waits; the returning probe(P3, P1, P1) has P1 as both waited-on process and initiator, so P1 declares a deadlock after 3 probes.

spec.aria: Sequence diagram of sites S1, S2 and S3 exchanging three probes: probe(P1, P2, P1) from S1 to S2, probe(P2, P3, P1) from S2 to S3, and probe(P3, P1, P1) returning from S3 to S1, where initiator P1 sees its own name in the second field and closes the cycle P1 → P2 → P3 → P1.
